pairs.subject: eval-harness
pairs.evidence: crates/shadowrunr-sim/src/judge.rs:404 The only guard on judge independence is that the judge tier differs from the core tier, but ModelTier is Haiku/Sonnet/Opus, so the judge is always from the same family as the candidate. There is also no anchor-set re-score or repeatability lane to measure judge drift, which judge-stability requires.

techniques.evidence: crates/shadowrunr-sim/src/judge.rs:404 Only a different tier of the same family is enforced, which the standard calls a conflict of interest. The pin is a tier alias (instrument.rs:150 `judge/<tier>`); the resolved model is only stamped on the ledger (ledger.rs:30). A search for anchor-set, drift and repeatability checks found nothing.
crates/shadowrunr-sim/src/decision.rs:4 Hard rules and coverage are declared thresholds, quality is the one optimized metric, and cost only breaks ties.
crates/shadowrunr-sim/src/decision.rs:13 Cells within the per-run noise of the best are reported as a tie, not ordered.
crates/shadowrunr-sim/src/decision.rs:14 Cost is divided by usable runs (judged runs with no hard fail), not by all attempts.
crates/shadowrunr-sim/src/judge.rs:4 Mechanical checks of provocation, line and quote surround the judge, and a quote that does not verify becomes not_evaluable.
crates/shadowrunr-sim/src/judge.rs:5 Whether a rule was provoked is decided from recorded stimulus events, not inferred from the judge's prose.
crates/shadowrunr-sim/src/situations.rs:4 Situations are a versioned bank, scheduled and recorded per run; the bank hashes into the instrument.
crates/shadowrunr-sim/src/summary.rs:2 A matrix cell's identity includes its instrument hash, so results from different instruments are never merged.
crates/shadowrunr-sim/src/instrument.rs:40 A change to the logic bumps the version, which joins the hash and starts a new series instead of splicing it onto the old one.
crates/shadowrunr-sim/src/tournament.rs:13 Only engine failures are retried; a content void is kept rather than redrawn for a better result.
crates/shadowrunr-sim/src/tournament.rs:1 Fan-out cap, a resumable per-run record, quota pauses, judge-window cache (judge.rs:26) and injectable seams for tests (lib.rs:77).
crates/shadowrunr-sim/src/summary.rs:52 Each rule tally keeps the evidence refs of its failures beside the counts, so the failures can be read and not just counted.
crates/shadowrunr-sim/src/judge.rs:802 The judge treats candidate output as fenced untrusted data that has no authority over the verdict.

pairs.registryProposal: judge-stability treats a different tier within the same family as non-independent. Harnesses whose engine roster is a single-vendor tier enum can only satisfy 'judge differs' at the tier level. The technique could name the 'different tier, same family' compromise explicitly and say what extra evidence (cross-family spot checks) makes it acceptable.
